description: This file defines a Firebase messaging service that handles incoming messages and notifications for the application.

classes.name: FirebaseMessageService
classes.description: A service that extends FirebaseMessagingService to handle message reception and token updates.

methods.name: onNewToken
methods.description: Called when a new token for the Firebase Cloud Messaging service is generated.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Called when a message is received. It processes the message and shows a notification.

methods.name: createNotificationChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel for Android O and above.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Displays a notification to the user with the provided title, body, and data.
